title: Absorption and renal handling of phosphate from diphosphates
compartment: Gut lumen, small-intestinal epithelium, plasma and renal proximal tubule

steps.note: Rats fed diphosphate excrete orthophosphate, not diphosphate, in urine
Apical NaPi-IIb (SLC34A2) with 3 Na⁺, plus passive diffusion
About 200 mmol phosphorus filtered per day
Proximal tubules reabsorb 80% or more of filtered phosphorus
